item.title: ‘In our lands the rain is made of bullets’: Palestinian artists look back in anger, melancholy and defiance
item.description: IMMA, Dublin From massacre locations painted on to basalt slabs to photocollages of bulldozed airports, artists from across the Levant address their traumatic history In 2006, Simone Fattal painted on to basalt slabs the names of places indelibly associated with massacres in the Levant since 1948: Deir Yassin; Jenin; Qana; Sabra. item.title: Historic Charleston mansion sells for $13.3 million
item.description: Charleston's historic Roper House, famous for its notable guests, has been sold for a staggering $13.3 million.
